text_block_list.text: A few days ago—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Spring has... arrived, hasn't it? The 
season of the Classics."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wanted this to be a warm spring, but the 
wind feels a little chilly...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I've gone and put you through such a 
painful ordeal too, Trainer."

Despite struggling with her poor form from 
the Sumire Stakes... Super Creek pushed 
herself with desperate effort.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can keep going a bit more~. Just a bit 
more...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Y... You're... right. If I push any 
further, I'll definitely just cause more 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel so pathetic for always making 
Trainer worry about me. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you at least let me help out 
with something else?

I decided to go shopping with Super Creek 
so she could get a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Whew, it's been so long since I had this 
much fun♪ Shopping like this, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If there's anywhere else you'd like to 
drop by, please let me know, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shall we go share a parfait or 
something friendly like that? My treat! As 
the least I can do to apologize.

She looks like she's having fun for the 
first time in a while. Just as I thought 
that—

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
'Uma Musume fans, thank you for waiting! 
It's time for this month's Race 
Flaaaash!!'

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, let's take a look at the 
training of the top contenders for the 
Satsuki Sho."

âOne after another, Umamusume appeared 
on the public display screens.

Every one of them ran across the screen in 
high spirits...

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
"However, it is a shame that Super Creek 
isn't among these contenders."

text_block_list.name: TV Color Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Indeed. It seems uncertain if she will 
run. She was an Umamusume with high 
expectations for the future, though.’"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know. It can't be helped, right? I 
brought this upon myself...

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Super Creek's 
Trainer is apparently a rookie with 
absolutely zero track record."

text_block_list.name: TV Color Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, her inexperience really showed 
there. It's a shame to see such raw talent 
held back like that."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san... May I... head back to 
the academy?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I really want to train. If only I... If 
only this hadn't happened to me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Still, because of me, they're saying 
awful things about you, Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to make them smile... so, so 
much...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best. I need to bring 
Trainer lots and lots of happiness...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I... Ugh, uuu...

Returning to the trainer's office— I think 
about Super Creek's slump.

Earlier, the moment Super Creek felt the 
responsibility of 'I have to do my best,' 
her face turned pale.

I have no proof. I don't have any proof, 
but still...
choice_data_list:
Could that be the reason for your 
slump...?

text_block_list.text:
"I might have just noticed something 
crucial. —Let's observe the situation a 
little longer."
